sources.label: Material You, ad and tracker removal, and premium unlocks for Android apps.
sources.author: Fakh
patch_list: Lets short movies play while Developer options are turned on, instead of asking to turn them off.
Stops the analytics and crash reporting SDKs (AppsFlyer, CleverTap, Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, Google Tag Manager, comScore and Facebook events) from collecting data. Push notifications stay.
Removes the Google ad banners from the home, article, quiz, event and live screens, and the promo popups.
Removes the "+" button (write news, start a live stream) from the middle of the bottom navigation. The switch for it is on the Fakh Patches page.
Adds switches to hide the Nonton, IDN Live, Berita and Quiz tabs, on a Fakh Patches page in the app's Settings.
Removes the "Beli Paket" banner from the profile, since packages cannot be bought in a patched app. The switch for it is on the Fakh Patches page.
Opens connect.idn.media/my-account/gold in the browser instead of the in-app Gold top up.
Adds a switch to stop the video previews and the automatic sliding of the home banners, on a Fakh Patches page in the app's Settings.
